question: On the identical qualified one-determinization combat planner, does the previously specified public-effect/owned-partner acquisition adapter improve Bloodfire support without loss of win quality and without collapsing Hand support?
why_not_a_retry: The closed acquisition study changed acquisition while retaining weak shipping combat. The closed one-sample study changed combat while retaining acquisition blind to Bloodfire. This is a separately frozen interaction/composition test: both arms use the SAME one-sample combat procedure; ONLY acquisition differs. Neither old experiment, old scalar choice, sample assignment or result is overwritten. No additional sample count, weight, root or seed rescues either old nomination.

evidence.observations: One-sample value66->316 wins/512 and2187.73 CPU seconds passes value/cost, but Bloodfire26 active fails32. All128 configurations had at least one same-run two-role offer, only40 had final co-ownership and26 activation. This is descriptive evidence, not proof an offer was affordable or optimal.
evidence.prior_acquisition: Exact source adapter had qualified interfaces and increased activation11->42 under shipping combat, but55->53 wins failed its fixed value test. That terminal stays closed. Stronger combat is the changed prerequisite, not a new fitted reward coefficient.

single_nomination.reference: Preserved one-sample planner with unchanged shipping acquisition
single_nomination.combined: Identical planner plus acquisition-v1/bridge.py source and counterpart terms; exact same coefficients and tie-breaking
single_nomination.boundary_delta: Add random_play to the acquisition guard so all signed random arms are unchanged. In both experimental arms random_build=random_play=false; this guard has no effect on their active scores.
single_nomination.no_other_changes: No content, laws, observer estimand, policy sampler/distribution/root, card injections, bans, public/hidden state, RNG, potions, removal/upgrade logic, descriptor fitting, heuristic weight, caches or continuation depth changes.

assignment.seed_rule: Reject overlap with retained executable configuration metadata before any new outcome; this is not a claim of final seed-independent package confirmation.

comparison: Use unchanged acquisition-v1/compare_value.py: activation increase>=.05, exact one-sided paired configuration sign p<=.025 per vow, nonnegative observed win difference, 95% configuration-bootstrap lower bound>-.05, both inherited support conjunctions. Same128 vectors and four common seeds per arm. Conditional inference only; no configuration is an independent seed.
qualification: Bind runtime from completed one-sample capture; prove only owned acquisition functions differ and full product/combat/observer source is identical. Reuse corrected full-catalogue acquisition oracle. Compare384 active/off/producer-off/consumer-off combat queries to preserved one-sample outputs. Compare both runtime endpoints for RandomBuild, RandomPlay, combined-random modes and ordinary Dusk; all must be exact. Keep query traces read-only, cost/legality and full factual/clone/null checks on every population consumer.
execution: Complete512 assigned outcomes per arm at V5, then analyze once. V5 all gates and actual full method CPU<=3600 only opens the identically fixed V0 rectangle. Otherwise stop. At most2048 population outcomes total; no resampling, automatic third composition, increased coefficients or extension after a negative.
preservation: Commit source and generated runtime identities before observations. Sole writer preserves complete matched groups and every available failure. Cold-checkout raw/source byte equality, rebuild decisions with unchanged readers, and preserve all old terminals. No static registration counts or workflow-green status is a scientific PASS.
success_scope: Only this composed controller and necessary pair-support claim. Full causal/descriptor/viability, independent package confirmation, remaining four strategy slots, detector, retention, guardrails and product integration are still required.
